title: Income statement: from revenue to EPS
summary: Revenue minus cost of sales gives gross profit; minus operating expenses gives operating profit; minus interest and tax gives net income. Divide by the number of shares for EPS.
unreliableWhen: When one-off gains or costs distort a single year, when accounting choices record sales before cash is collected, or when you read one year without the trend.
goodExample: A fictional food maker grows revenue 2% a year and net income grows at about the same pace, so its margins hold steady.
badExample: A fictional app maker grows revenue 50% in a year, but net income grows only 20% because costs and interest grow almost as fast.
